user.title: Create a relay cover
user.description: Create a shutter that is moved by two relays: one to open it and one to close it. Each relay keeps the motor running while it is on.

data_description.name: The name of the new shutter.
data_description.open_relay: The switch that moves the shutter up while it is on.
data_description.close_relay: The switch that moves the shutter down while it is on.
data_description.opening_time: Seconds the shutter needs to go from fully closed to fully open.
data_description.closing_time: Seconds the shutter needs to go from fully open to fully closed.
data_description.interlock: Never turn both relays on at the same time, and pause half a second before changing direction. Turn it off only if the relays already protect the motor.
data_description.end_margin: When opening or closing fully, keep the relay on this percent of the full travel time longer, so that the shutter really reaches the end. 0 turns it off; 100 always runs a full travel.
data_description.hide_relays: Hide the two switches, so the shutter is used instead of them.

error.same_relay: The open relay and the close relay must be different.
error.relay_in_use: One of the relays is already used by another relay cover.
error.invalid_travel_time: The opening and closing times must be greater than zero.

relay_removed.title: A relay of {cover} was removed
relay_removed.description:
The relay {relay} of the shutter {cover} no longer exists, so the shutter cannot move as it should.

To fix it, go to **Settings** > **Devices & services** > **Helpers**, select **{cover}** and choose **Configure**. Choose another relay and save: the shutter reloads with it and this issue goes away.

If the relay {relay} is added back, this issue goes away on its own.
